properties.description: Live/work and creative commercial property documented by Artspace. Archival address evidence does not establish a current vacant unit.

properties.name: Brookland Artspace Lofts
properties.description: Artist live/work property in Brookland. This is a D.C. index record outside the HQ2 Anacostia corridor, not an HQ2 building claim.

properties.name: Artspace Jackson Flats
properties.description: Artist loft community described by its property manager. The address includes a half-numbered avenue; no rent or eligibility result is copied.

properties.name: Northern Warehouse Artist Lofts
properties.description: Artist live/work lofts identified by the property manager. The record is discovery metadata, not an application or vacancy confirmation.

properties.name: Anacostia Arts Center
properties.description: Arts and small-business venue documented by the center. Its contact page reports a renovation closure; a public closure is not evidence of physical vacancy.

operatingNotice.text: Operator contact page reports temporary closure for renovation. Confirm with the operator before visiting.

properties.name: Artscape Youngplace
properties.description: Creative studio and cultural property documented in Artscape’s portfolio. Operator history and source age require review before any transaction or tenancy representation.

properties.name: 401 Richmond
properties.description: Creative commercial building with galleries and workspaces, identified by its own website. No individual tenancy or leasing offer is indexed.

properties.name: Friche la Belle de Mai
properties.description: Multi-organisation creative and cultural site. This record uses the documented Jobin pedestrian entrance; the Simon entrance belongs to the same site and is not a second property record.

properties.name: Künstlerhaus Bethanien · showrooms
properties.description: Exhibition location listed by Künstlerhaus Bethanien. Its studio/office entrance has a separate address and is represented as a related place.

properties.name: Künstlerhaus Bethanien · studios and office
properties.description: Studio and office location listed by Künstlerhaus Bethanien, distinct from the showroom entrance. No public entry or studio vacancy is implied.

properties.name: Carriageworks
properties.description: Arts venue location documented by Carriageworks. Event opening times and any venue rental require separate operator confirmation.

properties.name: Abbotsford Convent
properties.description: Arts precinct with studio and office spaces documented by the operator. No individual studio or current vacancy is asserted.

properties.name: Hayward Gallery
properties.description: Contemporary art venue documented by Southbank Centre. The source reports an exhibition-change closure; that does not indicate leasing availability.

operatingNotice.text: Source reports closure before planned reopening on 24 November 2026. Recheck the operator before visiting.

properties.name: Cockpit Bloomsbury
properties.description: Maker studio location published by Cockpit. Studio applications, selection and actual available space remain with the operator.

properties.name: Cockpit Deptford
properties.description: Maker studio location published by Cockpit. This record does not create a listing, application or rental agreement.

properties.name: Art Design Xchange · ADX
properties.description: Creative workspace and maker facilities identified by the operator. Membership and private studio availability are not verified here.

properties.name: Anacostia Playhouse
properties.description: Theater location documented in the Playhouse’s 2024 brochure. Current operations and facility availability have not been independently confirmed.

properties.name: South Main Artspace Lofts
properties.description: Artist live/work and creative commercial development. The property contact address is recorded without implying a vacant unit.

properties.name: Artspace El Paso Lofts
properties.description: Loft property and artist workspace location identified by the property site and Artspace. Current permitted use and available units require operator confirmation.

properties.name: Artspace Mt. Baker Lofts
properties.description: Mixed-use artist live/work and commercial development documented by Artspace. No unit, price or current occupancy is verified.

properties.name: Everett Station Lofts
properties.description: Artist live/work and storefront property documented by Artspace. This Portland place is distinct from Artspace Everett Lofts in Everett, Washington.

properties.description: Artist live/work development documented by its development partner. Historical leasing claims on the source are not treated as a current occupancy check.
